briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind race to deploy agentic systems amid escalating compute arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multimodal agent deployment as regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Funding remains robust with major rounds closing across infrastructure and safety tooling. DialectForge gains traction in enterprise pilots for protocol-level security.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with extended reasoning chains; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google unveils Gemini 3.0 with native tool use. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant. xAI Colossus v2 training run hits 1.2T tokens this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with patent-pending multi-agent security for automotive, IoT and BCI.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 2nm AI chips for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft announces $15B Arizona data center expansion. Saudi Arabia commits $8B to sovereign AI cluster with Cerebras.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems achieve autonomous economic activity at scale before 2028 regulatory frameworks mature?
